verdict.rationale: Calendly's marketing says users can fine-tune availability with custom schedules, buffers and daily limits. That supports defining working-hour schedules. Calendar sync blocks conflicting busy time, which could indirectly cover time off, and an API exposes user availability data. However, the evidence never mentions date-specific overrides or dedicated out-of-office periods. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of date overrides, out-of-office/vacation blocking, detailed working-hours configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
